Data Scientist – Credit Risk
Nordbank N.V. · Amsterdam (hybrid)

Your responsibilities
- Develop and validate credit risk models
- Translate business questions into analyses and present results to stakeholders
- Work with data engineers to productionise models

Your profile
- MSc or PhD in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field
- 2+ years of hands-on experience with Python or R
- Excellent SQL skills
- Solid grounding in statistics and machine learning
- Strong communication skills; you can explain a model to a non-technical audience
- Experience with Spark or dbt is a plus

What we offer
- Competitive salary, 13th month and annual bonus
- Hybrid working, laptop of your choice
- Excellent pension and health benefits, relocation support

Nordbank values diversity and is committed to equal opportunity.
Contact: recruitment@nordbank.example
